with matched as (select max(applied_at) as at from migrations.history where model_hash = $1)
      select
        (select json_build_object('name', name, 'protobase_version', protobase_version, 'model', model, 'model_hash', model_hash) from migrations.history order by applied_at desc limit 1) as newest,
        (select at is not null from matched) as matched,
        (select coalesce(json_agg(h.name order by h.applied_at), '[]') from migrations.history h, matched where h.applied_at > matched.at and h.additive is not true) as not_additive,
        (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('name', h.name, 'after', h.physical -> 'after') order by h.applied_at), '[]') from migrations.history h where h.completed_at is null) as unfinished
select "primary".* from (select * from "session" where "session"."user_id" = $1 limit $2) as "primary"
